message.content: {"verdict":"REPLICATED","confidence":0.88,"justification":"Independent classical simulations on a nontrivial Heisenberg instance reproduced the paper’s core claims: (i) all cancellation constraints were satisfied to machine precision; (ii) global error scaling matched the predicted order −2m across 2m=2..12; (iii) the well-conditioned constructions (Chebyshev closed-form and rounded-integer) exhibited bounded ||a||_1 consistent with the O(log m) behavior, while Chin’s coefficients showed exponential growth; and (iv) the Appendix A tabulated coefficients were verified verbatim. Although LCU circuit implementation, commutator-dependent bounds, and large-N scaling were not tested, these are ancillary to the core numerical/theoretical claims about the multiproduct constructions’ order and conditioning, which were convincingly replicated.","one_line_summary":"Order and conditioning replicated; tables verified; circuit/large-N aspects untested but noncritical."}
